title: French-Style Lentil Stew
description: A hearty French-inspired stew made with lentils and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, carrots, and celery, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add lentils, wine (if using), and broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30-40 minutes or until lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
